A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 20-page versions of the same work, including Appendices A–E. Text comparison and rendered-page checks support reliable comparison of all research content.

before.justification: v1 reports original image-ranking experiments and ablations in Section 4, with additional dataset evaluations, sensitivity analyses, and qualitative results in the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains the original experimental results in Section 4 and Appendices A–E, including the proposed method's benchmark scores and ablations.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same frozen CLIP backbone, learnable prompts, cross-attention adapter, regression and pairwise ranking branches, relational attention, and combined regression/ranking objective. Appendix inference procedures also match.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same Adience, HCI, KonIQ-10k, AVA, and COCO-REM evaluations, plus UTKFace, CLEVR, LVIS, and AGIQA-3k in the appendices. Specific-count queries, unseen-category tests, and multiple-attribute scenarios are unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership matches throughout the main and appendix experiments, including CoOp, OrdinalCLIP, L2RCLIP, and NumCLIP in Table 1, and CLIP and InstructBLIP in the CLEVR comparison in Table 8.

E3.justification: Sections 4.1–4.2 and the appendices retain identical splits, preprocessing, metrics, model configurations, training budgets, and testing procedures. Neither existing protocols nor additional experimental settings change.

E4.justification: The branch and attention-component ablations in Tables 5–6, multitask comparison and sensitivity analyses in Tables 10–12, and failure cases and qualitative analyses in Appendices C–E are unchanged.

E5.justification: Table 1 retains the same mean and standard-deviation reporting. No repeated-run, seed, uncertainty-estimation, confidence-interval, or significance-testing information is added or revised.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–12 and qualitative results in Figures 4–12 match. For example, Table 2 retains the proposed method's PLCC of 0.624 and SRCC of 0.557, while Table 7 retains UTKFace MAE of 3.83.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and Equations (1)–(6), covering attention, pairwise differences, and training losses, are identical. No assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs are added, removed, or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about text-guided image ranking, the lightweight ranking-aware adapter, and performance relative to CLIP baselines and task-specific methods.

C2.justification: The mechanism explanations and limitations remain identical, including category-specific bias, missing ground truth for multiple-attribute rankings, incompatibility with triplet-based losses, and the failure cases discussed in Appendices C–E.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware, preprocessing, and prompts in Section 4.2 and the appendices are unchanged. The code-availability statement and link target also match.

R1.justification: Section 2 and the cited works are unchanged. The bibliography text matches after accounting for whitespace and page-boundary shifts caused by the new acknowledgment.

P1.justification: v2 adds Section 6, a brief acknowledgment of National Science and Technology Council funding, and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. The research prose and appendix organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The acknowledgment shifts the reference block and changes bibliography layout across pages 11–13. All research figures, tables, captions, and appendix layouts remain identical.

improvement.justification: v2 adds funding credit and updates the version stamp, with minor bibliography reflow. The methods, evidence, explanations, reproducibility information, and limitations are unchanged, so these administrative edits do not meaningfully alter the paper's overall quality.
